editorialObservations.observation: The conclusion and bridge have large vertical gaps. This is a sparse composition, not a correctness defect.
The early broad-topic title is absent at the hold. The focused question and excluded topics provide the remaining context.
The receipt legend markers have large horizontal distances from their labels, but their pairings remain understandable.

The lower-left crossing joins two identically colored solid strips, so its over/under order is visually ambiguous. Other crossings preserve the weave cue; this is lower-impact pattern differentiation.
The featured value panel and other widgets have substantial empty interior space. This is a sparse default-content composition, not a data or readability defect.
The stack sits well above its labeled reading tray with a large empty gap. The destination is named, but the hold does not visually place the stack on the tray.
The central divider extends far below the last row into empty space. This does not obscure content.
The receiving-team figure and the cargo bike's front wheel overlap at the right edge of the hold, creating mild pictorial congestion. Parcel identity and labels remain clear.
The equation uses the same Stored energy wording for its initial and final positions. Their equation positions distinguish them, but explicit initial/final wording would be clearer.
The coverage-unit row sits close to the bottom image edge, with about5 px of margin. It remains readable and is not visibly clipped.
The resolved shared-table arrangement still uses three adjacent table surfaces with narrow gaps, rather than a single continuous top. This does not change the fraction representation.
The bottom comparison label has a small bottom margin, but its second line remains visible.
The column-c focus outline runs very close to the top of its wrapped header, but no definite glyph clipping is visible.
The entering replacement panel extends beyond the right image edge at frame90, while its visible label is intact. It is fully inside the image at the hold.
The faded central question mark sits on the divider during action 90, but remains recognizable and clears at the hold.
The moving fifth copy partly covers its identical original at action 90. This is transient pictorial congestion around the depicted copy operation; no different field or final data is lost.
The receiving figure meets the cargo bike's front-wheel area at the hold, repeating low-impact pictorial congestion seen in the default.

The tiny decimal values and the raw net-equation operands/results wrap within their numeric tokens across two lines. The displayed floating-point residue near −2000 is not treated as a material balance error here, but numerical presentation would benefit from separate formatting review.
Boundary-touch classification semantics were not audited beyond the rendered geometry. The focused footprint's cross-district status is unambiguous.
The moving appointment is a blank dashed outline at action90 and becomes a labeled card by the hold. Playback remains necessary to judge the clarity of that transition.
